Evelyn — thanks for the clear recap. I looped in our security ops mailbox to fill out the questionnaire; we returned a partially completed version attached and added notes where we need detail. Answers below to your numbered questions: 

1) Deletion SLA: our minimum requirement is that live copies of PII are removed within 24 hours of a deletion request. For backups, the standard legal hold window is 180 days, but we prefer options that let us truncate a customer’s data earlier if needed.
2) Backups: proof of retention + ability to attest to a customer-scope snapshot deletion is acceptable; we don’t need raw snapshot access.
3) Additional constraints: HIPAA plus a requirement to keep an auditable trail per-deletion request; no state-level residency requirements at the moment.

See attached: MedAlign_Security_Questionnaire_filled_partial.xlsx — we flagged rows 14, 27, and 39 for clarification.

Would like to set the technical call for Thu Jul 1 or Fri Jul 2 morning ET.

Thanks Susan — really helpful. Quick answers and where we'll provide options in the proposal: 

- Live deletion: we can support a 24-hour SLA for removing PII from live indexes and primary stores. We implement an immediate logical delete followed by background purge tasks; we will document steps and provide runbook entries for audit.

- Backups / snapshots: standard retention in our hosted config is 90 days for incremental snapshots, but for enterprise we offer configurable retention policies up to 365 days. For customer-scoped truncation we support an API-driven purge that invalidates snapshots for a customer and we can provide attestations (audit record + timestamp) once the purge job completes. We will include a model for 90/180/365-day retention options in the draft SLA.

- Audit trail: all deletion requests are logged (requestor, timestamp, job id, affected resource). We can provide an export of those logs for an agreed retention period; we will propose 3 years by default with shorter windows available.

Action items from Redwood:
1) Ben will prepare the retention SLA draft with three guardrail options (aggressive: 30-day backups; standard: 90-day; conservative: 365-day) + explicit language about customer-scoped snapshot purges and attestations.
2) Markus will join the technical call to walk through the purge flow and logging evidence.
3) Evelyn will coordinate the mutual action plan and HubSpot updates.

Proposed meeting: Thu Jul 1, 10:30am ET — does that work for your security ops team?

If yes, I'll send an invite and include a short runbook excerpt in the meeting pack so we can walk through end-to-end deletion.

Cheers,
Evelyn Hart
